title: CISLIB Management v1 HTTP contract

metadataETag.description: One strong opaque metadata ETag; clients never derive authority or revisions by parsing it.

maximumInventoryRequestBytes.description: Effective complete-inventory request bytes accepted by this server and selected provider; absent on older v1 servers.

key.description: Original management operation key; exact dot and dot-dot segments are excluded to prevent URI path normalization.

metadataETag.description: One strong opaque metadata ETag; clients never derive authority or revisions by parsing it.

MetadataResult.description: Exactly one nonnull typed result or native rejection. The opposite branch may be omitted or null. Original decision, original persistence and later attempt cleanup remain separate.

OperationRejection.description: The unchanged native RM03 OperationError. It contains no original metadata, revision or decision timestamp.

ControlConfirmation.x-cis-freshness-origin: Local monotonic request start, including actual response cleanup; never response arrival.
ControlConfirmation.x-cis-authority: A current backend confirmation, not business permission, presence or RM-05 ownership.

defaultsJson.description: Exact declared defaults, omitted unless actual source-content-read authority permits disclosure. Omission is redaction, never an empty or changed defaults contract.

ConfigurationDefinition.x-cis-source-qualified-discovery: One authorized source stream per row. Global immutable schema/defaults are repeated without making host scope a schema identity. Authorization filters rows before pagination.

description: Canonical DTO schemas. Requests are closed; response readers tolerate optional additions and preserve unknown raw values. x-cis annotations document runtime lexical/semantic/byte requirements not all expressible in JSON Schema or the existing evaluator.
x-cis-limit-profile: Schemas express absolute supported ceilings; x-cis-default-* annotations state initial operational limits. Actual configured limits are enforced at runtime and may be lower.
